propositions: A deterministic repository scanner with a count-pinned, tab-delimited plain-text allowlist must enforce the deprecated Success Criteria vocabulary policy, accepting only documented deliberate matches with exact pinned occurrence counts.

Live prose in src/rebar/llm/completion.py, tests/interfaces/store/test_completion_verifier.py, and docs/sample-ticket-log.jsonl must be migrated from Success Criteria to Acceptance Criteria terminology and removed from allowlist scope.

The guard must enforce scoped bare-token rules (bare SC/SCs only permitted in src/rebar/llm/reviewers/, src/rebar/_guides/, criteria_routing.json files, and generated docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md) and reject bare tokens elsewhere in live source paths.
The root Makefile lint target must wire the guard check so local and CI runs enforce the same vocabulary policy, and injection tests must prove lint fails on reintroduced deprecated vocabulary.

The guard must detect malformed allowlist entries (missing fields, non-positive counts, duplicate paths, stale entries) and count drift in either direction, failing deterministically with diagnostic output.

Frozen records (Jira captures, migration/lifecycle probes, reviewer carve-outs, historical citations) must remain accepted only at their documented pinned counts, and O-RAN-SC references and the minified editor.js bundle must remain byte-identical and unaffected by the guard.
